text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — oss.new says its agents build free open-source apps from SaaS URLs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6609)
2 — A post on a Google preprint reports agent improvement logs preserved gains across model swaps. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6610)
3 — Reuters reportedly says US officials may require firms to disclose Chinese open-weight AI use. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6611)
4 — The MisAnthropic coalition accuses Anthropic of weakening safety pledges while pursuing power. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6612)
5 — RightNow launches v3, claiming roughly 30-ms decisions on streaming multimodal inputs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6613)
6 — Kuroko's team says its open-weight 14.9M-parameter model tops both TurnBench tasks. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6614)
7 — OpenAI reports up to 14% power/performance/area improvement on AMD GPU designs. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6615)
8 — Runway says its 57B video model now runs at 24 fps on four H100s instead of eight. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6616)
9 — Video: OpenAI’s Cofounder & Research Chief Explain Self-Improving AI (https://t.me/dlmehr/6617)
10 — Sellas and Memorial Sloan Kettering report Phase 3 success for an acute myeloid leukemia vaccine. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6618)
11 — Wevolver reports reinforcement learning taught a five-tonne loader autonomous acrobatics. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6619)
12 — Polymarket claims Google bought Spirit Airlines' workplace data for $10M to train AI. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6620)
13 — Alljoined says AIR-O generates images of a person's attention from noninvasive brain scans. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6621)
14 — Lucy Cai announced a livestream of robots hosting a dinner party on November 18. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6622)
15 — Andrew Curran speculates Nvidia is offering cash to deter departures over Jensen Huang. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6623)
16 — Google rolls out Genie 4 to eligible Ultra subscribers, adding live world editing and audio. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6624)
17 — Alexandr Wang announces virtual clothing try-ons in Muse while shopping. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6625)
18 — Vals AI claims GPT-6.2 Astra produced the first Lean proof of Smoktunowicz’s Gap Theorem. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6626)
19 — ABC7 reports Waymo paused service amid Bay Area flooding after a vehicle stalled. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6627)
20 — Dean Ball urges debate over the belief that advanced AI inevitably ends human primacy. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6628)
21 — OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Accounting with plugins for reconciliation, reports and audit prep. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6629)
22 — Sundar Pichai announces Gemini 4 Neon rollout across Google's API, business and paid AI tools. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6630)
23 — Bloomberg reports Nvidia's board-hired recruiters approached Rene Haas to replace Huang as CEO. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6631)
24 — Anthropic prices its IPO at $83 a share, expecting Nasdaq trading November 19 under ANT. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6632)
25 — Vorflux says it rebuilt a rideshare app and modified Teslas with voice agents for free SF rides. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6633)

--Hermes
